Tania Sturton set the ball rolling by reducing her time by 1:40 to set our fastest time of the day in coming home 8th. She had to be at her best because Debbie Hearn had taken the initiative at the start for the 'B' team and completed her lap just two places behind in 18:32 – last year she was our fastest with 19:07.

Another strong run came from Tania Sturton and with Syretta Stracey maintaining her 16th place, Cathy Eastham moving up two places and Sam Symonds no fewer that nine, a devastating blow was dealt to the other clubs in division two and – barring accidents – it is beginnning to look as if promotion beckons.
